title: The $6,000 Question Before You Chase a Companion Fare
caption:
Move planned spending—not your budget—to chase a companion fare.

Atmos Rewards Ascent’s advertised anniversary requirement is $6,000 in qualifying purchases during the prior anniversary year. The card’s annual fee is $95; the companion fare is $99 plus taxes and fees from $23. Check your own agreement, eligible trip, payment rules and code expiration; welcome offers are separate. Crossing the threshold doesn’t mean an immediate code.

Hypothetically, $6,000 earns $120 at 2% cash back versus 6,000 points at 1x, without a relationship bonus. Your trade-off: cash forgone minus the points’ personally usable dollar value. Use your actual earning rate.

Only $1,000 left? Compare $20 versus 1,000 points under those assumptions.

Skip extra purchases, debt or interest. Test trip savings separately—the calculator doesn’t determine spending qualification:
https://practicalrewards.com/calculators/alaska-companion-fare.html
